## Activity

During November 2018, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 97 captures. This activity provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The recorded volume should be considered alongside the number of examinations that could not be assessed and the results requiring referral.

## Image quality

Of the 97 captures, 4 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.1 per cent. The site should continue to monitor image quality and record any recurring camera issues through the service desk. Consistent logging will support review of equipment-related problems and help identify whether further action is required.

## Grading

A total of 12 results were graded referable. The median lag for grading was 6. This measure indicates the midpoint of the recorded wait for grading during November 2018 and should be reviewed with the monthly activity and image-quality results. Together, the figures provide a concise summary of operational performance at Oakridge Primary Care for the reporting month.
